parameters.name: pedal.sustain
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-API Events; SPEC-DMP Lift fraction
parameters.description: Sustain pedal depth P, 0 up to 1 fully down.

parameters.name: pedal.sostenuto
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-API Events; SPEC-DMP Sostenuto
parameters.description: Sostenuto pedal depth, 0 up to 1 fully down.

parameters.name: pedal.soft
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-API Events; SPEC-HAM Una corda
parameters.description: Soft pedal depth: una corda shift s on a grand, hammer-rail position on an upright. Also the una corda shift s (grand) and hammer-rail position (upright); the only id for that quantity.

parameters.name: output.gain
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-API Parameter classes
parameters.description: Master output gain in decibels (not linear).

parameters.name: sympathetic.gain
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-BODY Sympathetic path
parameters.description: Sympathetic coupling gain kappa_s (linear), default 1.

parameters.name: sympathetic.lowPass
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-BODY Sympathetic path; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Second-order low-pass frequency f_symp of the sympathetic path.

parameters.name: damper.tauUp
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-DMP Timing
parameters.description: Damper lift time constant tau_up.

parameters.name: damper.tau0
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-DMP Timing
parameters.description: Damper landing time constant tau_0 at zero release velocity.

parameters.name: damper.kRelease
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-DMP Timing
parameters.description: Release-velocity factor k_r of the landing time.

parameters.name: damper.halfPedalStart
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-DMP Lift fraction; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Half-pedal region start P_0 (must stay below P_1).

parameters.name: damper.halfPedalEnd
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-DMP Lift fraction; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Half-pedal region end P_1 (must stay above P_0).

parameters.name: damper.eta
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-DMP Lift fraction; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Progressive felt contact exponent eta_d.

parameters.name: unaCorda.s0
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-HAM Una corda; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Smoothstep lower bound s_0.

parameters.name: unaCorda.s1
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-HAM Una corda; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Smoothstep upper bound s_1.

parameters.name: unaCorda.kappaUC
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-HAM Una corda; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Felt stiffness factor kappa_uc.

parameters.name: unaCorda.deltaP
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-HAM Una corda; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Felt exponent shift Delta p_uc.

parameters.name: longitudinal.kappaL
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-GEO Transmission to the body; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Longitudinal transmission kappa_L (about sin 1.5 degrees).

parameters.name: longitudinal.modes
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-GEO Longitudinal modes; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Number of longitudinal modes M_L per string.

parameters.name: strings.fMax
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Highest kept string frequency f_max; default 16 kHz (SPEC-INST), V2 may revise. Structural: recompiles the instrument; EngineConfig::fMaxStrings is updated.

parameters.name: body.localBridgeModes
parameters.spec_key: SPEC-BODY Local bridge model; SPEC-INST Piano defaults
parameters.description: Private body modes M_b per bridge point (64 SHOULD hold).
